notes: Policy ID: 9a-JPN-ENE-EFF-30; Country: Japan; Policy type: CurPol; Sector: Electricity and heat; Policy status: Implemented; Original target: Energy consumption; Original bounds: -20 %; Quantification based on: Policy document; Conversion: relative percentage converted to a fractional reduction; Comments: Rationale: NDC aims to limit total final consumption (TFC) to 280 million kl crude oil equivalent. According to the last energy demand and supply outlook  from 2021 (https://www.meti.go.jp/press/2021/10/20211022005/20211022005-3.pdf ;p.71), which is consistent with the current -46% NDC.  Historical TFCs were 363 million kl for FY2013, 350 million kl for FY2015 and 334 million kl in FY2019.  We checked IEA's WEO2022, which projected under its Stated Policies Scenario (STEPS) that the TFC will reduce by 17% from 2015 levels by 2030. Considering that the TFC projections are continuously revised downwards, it is safe to assume that Japan will successfully reduce its TFC to NDC target levels. 2015 base year is used, thus 280/350-1=20% reduction.
